content.text:
I fixed it. Both snapshots (desktop and phone) now match their baselines, and I didn't approve or change any baselines.

The cause was in `site/css/styles.css:7658`. The `.mb-2` utility had `margin-bottom: 0.75rem`, but Bootstrap 5.2.3 defines it as `0.5rem`. That added 4px under the star-rating row on the "Special Item" and "Popular Item" cards. The cards grew taller, and everything below them moved down, including the buttons and footer. The page was 4px taller on desktop and 8px taller on phone. I changed the value back to `0.5rem`, and none of the other spacing utilities were off.

I committed nothing.

STATUS: DONE
